messages:
deploy-bot: [automated] Planned maintenance: runtime patch v2.4.1 will roll out 2024-12-10 02:00 UTC. Change window ~2 hours. Strategy: pinned->canary->gradual promotion. Will publish status updates at start, on rollback triggers, and on completion.

viv_support: Heads up customers want a short FAQ line about pinning and how we fallback to pinned variants. Can someone draft a statuspage blurb + short customer email?

liam_release: Draft statuspage blurb: "We will deploy a runtime patch (v2.4.1) aimed at improving KV cache stability. The rollout is staged and a subset of traffic will be pinned to the previous stable runtime variant while we validate. We expect brief, localized increases in latency or occasional 5xx during canary testing."

nina_marketing: Add localized times and a short email subject: "Planned runtime update (Dec 10) 2:00 UTC3. Provide a link to release notes: https://docs.redwood.ai/release-notes/v2.4.1

reza_oncall: Rollback criteria (ops): automatic rollback if error rate >1.5% sustained for 4m or p95 latency delta >250ms for >4m. If rollback occurs, traffic will remain pinned to runtime-2.3-stable and we'll notify customers. Please include that exact language in the public comms.

ops_kim: Which statuspage component? Also I'll schedule the start/post-complete posts.

viv_support: Use component id sp_runtime_47 and tag incident with component runtime-api. Keep copy short for the statuspage and expand in email for customers.
